headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 25, 2026**
article:
The Chicago Cubs dominated the day, taking down the New York Mets in two separate games. Dansby Swanson led the Cubs' offense with a historic performance in the first game, hitting two home runs and driving in seven runs. A.J. Ewing also had a strong game, leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs in the second game.

Several key players were placed on the injured list, including New York Mets second baseman Marcus Semien, who was placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hip flexor strain. Other notable injuries include Zack Gelof of the Athletics, Spencer Horwitz of the Pittsburgh Pirates, Steven Matz of the Tampa Bay Rays, Ryan McMahon of the New York Yankees, Jaden Hill of the Colorado Rockies, Ben Brown of the Chicago Cubs, and Edward Cabrera of the Chicago Cubs.

The Chicago Cubs made a notable trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher David Peterson from the New York Mets. The Cubs also acquired RHP Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros in a separate trade.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Rangers in 2-4 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 2-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with John King earning the win. Otto Lopez led the Marlins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 2-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Mets 10-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the New York Mets, securing a 10-3 victory. Dansby Swanson led the Cubs' offense with a historic performance, hitting two home runs and driving in seven runs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Mets 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 10-5 victory over the New York Mets, with A.J. Ewing leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Huascar Brazobán made a strong pitching appearance, striking out 4 batters in 2 innings without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a narrow win over the Chicago White Sox, with a final score of 4-3. Braden Montgomery led the Guardians' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marcus Semien Placed on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Mets second baseman Marcus Semien has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hip flexor strain.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire LHP David Peterson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being previously traded to the team.
